newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. airman charged with indecency in Okinawa.
newsitem.headline: U.S. airman charged with indecency in Okinawa.

text.p: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Air Force sergeant after he broke into a woman's apartment on the island of Okinawa, southern Japan, spokesmen for the U.S. Air Force and Japanese police said on Thursday.
Okinawa police spokesman Katsuya Matayoshi said the airman was being held by police on indecency charges.
"We arrested Sergeant Danney Matlock, 33 years old, and charged him with indecent exposure and breaking and entering," Matayoshi said.
Matlock is suspected of entering a 28-year-old woman's house shortly after midnight on Monday, the Okinawa police spokesman said.
A U.S. Air Force spokesman at the large Okinawa base at Kadena said U.S. Air Force police had helped Okinawa police in a three-day search for a suspect identified as a staff sergeant.
